name: JPL Horizons System API
tagline: NASA/JPL ephemerides API for solar-system body positions and trajectories
description: Public REST interface to the JPL Horizons System, providing high-precision ephemerides, osculating elements, and observer-table data for planets, asteroids, comets, and spacecraft. Industry standard for solar-system trajectories used in mission planning, astronomy apps, and research. Supports JSON and plain-text output with extensive query parameters for target bodies, coordinate systems, and time spans.

auth.details: No authentication required; public unauthenticated GET/POST endpoints

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans. Usage subject to fair-use rate limits (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: not published precisely; docs advise not exceeding ~1200 requests/hour and avoiding concurrent bulk scraping
use_cases: get observer-table RA/Dec for Mars from Earth on a date range
fetch osculating orbital elements for an asteroid by SPK-ID
compute spacecraft ephemeris relative to a center body
look up small-body designation and physical parameters
export state vectors for a solar-system body in a chosen reference frame
